findings.summary: The synchronous realm dispatched beforeunload/pagehide inside the closing frame's event drain, so that frame still ran and scene306's dispose made its bind check throw 459; the page now unloads once at run_engine_iterations' exit, after the last frame, on every exit path.
Worker modules accepted page lifecycle listeners that nothing dispatches; they now refuse, since a worker realm has no Window.

The pin's direct bucket (external-texture shader renderables) was folded into the opaque list; RenderItem::direct now sorts those draws after the bundled opaque ones, as the pass replays the bundle first, with contracts on both pinned _direct predicates.
The startup bind check was duplicated in both backends and covered only the root plan; one call in the shared upload_scene_meshes now covers the root and overlay plans before any texture work.
require_shader_external_textures was declared in the public runtime header over a forward-declared RenderPlan; it is now declared in renderer_plan.hpp behind the feature macro.
A pin-valid textureLoad on an external texture has no level, which the native texture_2d binding requires; the native module now adds level 0 to those calls.

setShaderExternalTexture refused after registration although uploads happen at the engine's first frame, and its draw-list epoch bump implied live rebinding that does not exist; the boundary is now engine start and the bump is gone.

Producer method bodies were never checked, so effects beyond the video's readyState would be dropped natively; a method that reaches anything outside the producer's own objects, or nests a function, now refuses.
The video bake copied the texture bake's Chromium child process; it now runs through evaluateInSharedPage, which gained a navigate option because an un-navigated page has no WebGPU.
The video bake key restated the closure inputs and could not see the shared loader it runs; it uses closureBakeInputs and holds the driver's own text.
The producer gate copied the texture gate's single-return walk and canvas test; both now share singleReturnedExpression (returns in any nested function-like node are its own) and createsElement.
External-texture names copied the sampler name check and skipped the pair limit; reserveSamplerPair is shared and the limit covers samplers and external textures together.
The native slot write re-implemented set_shader_texture and the pixels texture data; the video's frame is a PixelsTexture bound through set_shader_pixels_texture.
The pinned guards were found by substring over hand-rolled if-walks; they use findNodes with expressionMatchesShape and contractError.
The external slot index restated the binding order; it is read from shaderSamplerDeclarations, and the variant table's count from the program's externalTextures.
The getShaderExternalTexture body contract guarded nothing reached; it is replaced by installExternalTextureResolvers, whose active predicate the direct flag mirrors.

The bake carried shapes nothing reaches (several videos, a video without data, cross-method ordering) and a per-source memo; a producer now returns one video with a frame and at most one method, anything else refuses, and the durable bake cache alone replays.
The per-frame check copied each slot name into a std::string and each handle into a shared_ptr; it reads a const char* and a raw pointer.
The bake driver rebuilt its shader module and compute pipeline for every capture; both are created once with the device.
Three tests copied the same fixture-module declaration loader; test/fixture-functions.ts holds it once.
Naming nits: the lifecycle Set's comment claimed an order it does not drive, and the declaration helper in shaderSamplerDeclarations was named pairs.
Collect bound videos at draw-list epochs and check only readyState per frame instead of scanning the plan's shader items.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the pin checks every packet on every refresh; the scan is feature-gated to programs that declare external textures and costs one variant lookup per such item, while a cache would add invalidation on plan rebuilds and readyState changes.

findings.summary: Reuse the stillness fixture for the method measurement, overlap the settles and compare frames without JSON serialization.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: generation-time cost on a cache miss only (about a second with one method); a fresh producer per measurement keeps the method's state independent of the stillness check.

findings.summary: Merge window_beforeunload_event and window_pagehide_event into one parameterized constructor.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: they differ in bubbles and persisted, each stated against HTML's own event definition; a parameterized helper would restate both at its two call sites.

findings.summary: Drop setShaderExternalTexture's feature reach, which material creation already performs.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: every intrinsic reaches the feature it emits against; the reviewer agreed it is harmless.

findings.summary: Give setShaderTexture the same post-start refusal, since it shares the upload-once slot write.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the Doom and Quake demos call it on fresh materials during runtime level loads, which upload at their first draw; only re-binding an uploaded material is stale, and detecting that needs a per-material upload version in both backends' shared texture sets.
